soundSensor.deskripsiSensor: This is a new Analog Sound Sensor that is compatible with Arduino. This sensor uses a microphone that can detect sound and output an analog voltage signal. Sound Sensor is usually used to detect loudness in the surrounding environment, Arduino can collect its output signal and drive it. You can use it to create some funny interactive works like clapping and buzzing to find lost keys or remote control if you add a bell. This sensor works best with our Audio analyzer module.

gasSensor.deskripsiSensor: The MQ-2 Gas Sensor is a sensor that can detect gases such as LPG, i-butane, propane, methane, alcohol, hydrogen, smoke, and carbon monoxide. This sensor has two output pins, one is an analog output (AO) and the other is a digital output (DO). This sensor has high sensitivity and fast response time. This sensor is very suitable for gas detection applications.

lidarSensor.deskripsiSensor: The TF-Mini LiDAR Sensor is an optical distance measurement sensor based on laser time-of-flight technology mounted on the mannequin to detect object presence, obstacle perimeters, and proximity in real-time. It features high precision and fast response frequency for workplace safety and navigation applications.

cameraSensor.deskripsiSensor: The AMG8833 is the next generation of 8x8 thermal IR sensors from Panasonic, and offers higher performance than it's predecessor the AMG8831. The sensor only supports I2C, and has a configurable interrupt pin that can fire when any individual pixel goes above or below a threshold that you set. The sensor is essentially a thermal camera, that when connected to a microcontroller (or raspberry pi) will return an array of 64 individual infrared temperature readings over I2C. The driver board is compatible with any microcontroller that can communicate over I2C, or with a raspberry pi using the wiringPi library.

witmotionSensor.deskripsiSensor: The module combines high-precision gyroscopes, accelerometers, and geomagnetic sensors with advanced microprocessors and Kalman filtering. It provides real-time motion posture detection with 0.2° accuracy, stable heading.

adxlSensor.title: ADXL345 Accelerometer System (Limb Kinematics)
adxlSensor.dekripsiSensor: The ADXL345 is a high-resolution (13-bit) 3-axis digital accelerometer module mounted on the mannequin arms (Right Hand ADXL-201 and Left Hand ADXL-202). It measures static gravitational acceleration as well as dynamic acceleration resulting from motion, vibration, and impact in real time.

mpuSensor.title: MPU6050 Inertial Sensor (Accelerometer & Gyroscope)
mpuSensor.dekripsiSensor: Inside are two sensors, one is a classic 3-axis accelerometer, which can tell you which direction is downtowards the Earth (by measuring gravity). The other is a gyroscope that can sense how fast the board is being twisted around. By combining this data you can tell how your project is moving through space.

bmeSensor.title: BME280 Microclimate Monitoring System
bmeSensor.dekripsiSensor: The BME280 sensor is a high-precision digital environmental sensor by Bosch Sensortec that comprehensively measures ambient temperature, relative humidity, atmospheric pressure, and approximate altitude around the mannequin.
bmeSensor.chartSubtitle: Monitor environmental microclimate fluctuations (temperature, humidity, air pressure, and altitude) in an integrated view.

loadcellSensor.title: Load Cell Mechanical Load Distribution System
loadcellSensor.dekripsiSensor: The Load Cell sensors continuously measure mechanical load distribution and contact forces across 5 anatomical points of the mannequin: Neck, Left Thigh, Right Thigh, Left Foot, and Right Foot for comprehensive biomechanical evaluation.
loadcellSensor.chartSubtitle: Comparative load contour visualization across all mannequin transducer points.
loadcellSensor.summarySubtitle: Static and dynamic load measurement values across all anatomical points of the mannequin.

skinSensor.deskripsiSensor: Skin Sensor (Flex & Strain Gauge) monitors joint bending angles and surface strain across 8 body locations (Front & Back): Right/Left Shoulder, Right/Left Elbow, Right/Left Waist, and Right/Left Knee.

smartskinSensor.deskripsiSensor: Smart Skin is a multimodal sensing system integrated into the mannequin surface to detect real-time tactile and environmental stimuli. It features MCP9808 temperature sensors, FSR RP-S40-ST pressure sensors, piezoelectric impact sensors, and flex & strain gauge sensors for monitoring 8 joint articulation points (Shoulder, Elbow, Waist, Knee) across both Front and Back.
